{{Quote|Hey, let us out!|The Weequay, to Trace Martez|<ref name="Dangerous Debt" />}}
A [[Weequay]] [[Gender|male]] was a '''prisoner''' of the [[Pyke Syndicate]] within its [[Pyke Palace|fortress]] on the [[planet]] [[Oba Diah]] during the [[Clone Wars]], held in a [[prison]] cell alongside an [[Unidentified Ithorian prisoner|Ithorian]]. When the [[pilot]] [[Trace Martez]] managed to escape [[Torture|interrogation]], she ran past the Weequay's cell, but was caught by a [[Pyke]]. The Weequay urged Martez to let him and his fellow [[prisoner]] out, which Martez did, activating the door's controls with her foot as the Pyke attempted to hold her down. The two prisoners attacked the Pyke and charged at several reinforcements, which gave Martez a chance to escape. The Weequay and the Ithorian successfully escaped the [[fortress]], and later passed Martez and her fellow fugitives [[Rafa Martez]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]] in the streets of the nearby [[Oba Diah city|city]].<ref name="Dangerous Debt" />
